title: Cannot log period after pregnancy loss
body:
After a pregnancy loss, I ended the pregnancy record in the Health app. However, I can no longer log a normal period in Cycle Tracking. When I tap the date to record bleeding, the only option available is “Postpartum Bleeding.”

The pregnancy has already been marked as ended, and there are no ongoing pregnancy-related factors.

The only way to restore normal period tracking is to delete the entire pregnancy record, which also removes the pregnancy history.

Please allow users to keep their pregnancy history after a pregnancy loss while still being able to log a normal period. “Postpartum Bleeding” should not replace or prevent normal period tracking after a pregnancy loss.
